title: Square vs Clover POS vs Toast: Best Hospitality Pick

facts.fact: Tech.co's page states that Square POS is the best POS system for small and growing restaurants, due to its affordable pricing options and robust set of tools for selling and scaling.
facts.quote: due to its affordable pricing options, and robust set of tools for selling and scaling

facts.fact: Tech.co's page states that Toast is a better option for established, full-service restaurants because of its advanced hospitality features, such as tip-sharing and cost controls.
facts.quote: With its advanced hospitality features, such as tip-sharing and cost controls

facts.fact: Tech.co's page states that Clover POS is the best option for quick-service restaurants, due to its durable, spill-resistant hardware, slick backend, and low transaction fees.
facts.quote: due to its durable, spill-resistant hardware, slick backend, and low transaction fees.

facts.fact: Tech.co says its researchers tested 16 POS systems over the course of 40 user testing sessions for this guide and its other reviews.
facts.quote: we’ve tested 16 POS systems over the course

facts.fact: Tech.co reports that its POS testing across 40 user testing sessions amounted to 720 hours of testing in total.
facts.quote: which amounted to 720 hours of testing in total.

facts.fact: Tech.co's methodology weights software features at 30%, hardware at 15%, pricing at 10%, ease of use at 20%, help and support at 15%, and reputation at 10%.
facts.quote: software features (30%), hardware (15%), pricing (10%), ease of use (20%), help and support (15%), and reputation (10%)

facts.fact: Tech.co's methodology breaks its six core evaluation categories into 41 subcategories.
facts.quote: These categories were broken down into a further **41 subcategories**.

facts.fact: Tech.co states that Square and Toast offer free entry-level plans, while comprehensive features like 24/7 support or advanced reporting often require paid tiers.
facts.quote: While Square and Toast offer free entry-level plans

facts.fact: Tech.co states that Toast is an Android-exclusive POS system.
facts.quote: The only catch is that it’s an Android-exclusive system.

facts.fact: Tech.co states that Toast will not be suitable for retail businesses.
facts.quote: Toast will not be suitable for retail businesses, for instance.

facts.fact: Tech.co's page was updated on November 9, 2026.
Tech.co states that 100% of its reviews are researched, written, and edited by humans, and that AI cannot test POS systems.
facts.quote: 100% of Tech.co’s reviews are researched, written, and edited by humans.

facts.quote: We may receive a commission from our partners if you click on a link
